subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'by.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• With is used to say that people or things are in a place together or are doing something together.

 
 
• Example:* I was with Sylvia at the time.*
 
 
 
• When we use the passive voice, we can use a phrase with **by** to say who did the action.
 
 
• Example: *The new street was opened by the Mayor.*
 
 
 
• **In** is used for something inside or enclosed by so
